item.title: Whiskers 0.8.49
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.49

### AI Enhancement Prompts

  • Added always-visible enhancement prompts so you can choose or manage rewrite styles without first turning enhancement on
  • Improved prompt ordering so your custom prompts appear first while built-in options stay in a consistent order

    • ### Settings

  • Improved Settings consistency across API keys, microphone, license, support, permissions, and transcript views
  • Improved API key row controls so edit and delete actions reveal more cleanly with hover and keyboard focus
